Lisa's choir has 52 members, with 50% boys and 50% girls, so there are 26 girls. On the day of the performance, half of the female members (26 / 2 = 13) can't make it. This leaves 13 girls performing. The choir's 3 teachers then join them. 

So, the total number of people who sang in the performance is 13 + 3 = 16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 16
